Signed-off-by: dependabot[bot] <support@github.com>

* fix(tokenizer): use heuristic for large inputs to prevent CI timeout

CountTokens now falls back to the len(s)/4 heuristic for strings longer
than 8192 bytes instead of running the full tiktoken BPE encoder. The BPE
encoder on very large inputs (e.g. the 48500-char guardrail test prompt)
can take tens of seconds on a CPU-starved CI runner, causing the
TestChatDebugGuardrailRoutingReason test to time out.

The heuristic's ~15% relative error is acceptable for telemetry and
estimation purposes on large inputs. Normal-sized inputs continue to use
accurate tiktoken encoding.

Chapin"}],"committedDate":"2026-07-26T10:59:49Z","messageBody":"The metrics requests table grew without bound (~52M rows/year at 100
req/min). Add NEXUS_METRICS_RETENTION_DAYS (default 0 = disabled) which
starts a background prune goroutine that DELETEs rows older than the
configured window roughly once per hour, with best-effort
incremental_vacuum when the deletion count is large.

- Config: MetricsRetentionDays in config.go + metrics_retention_days
  YAML mirror + env-override branch. Not hot-reloadable.
- API: new metrics.OpenWithRetention(path, days, lg); Open and
  OpenWithLogger delegate with days=0.
- Prune goroutine fires an immediate pass at startup, then every hour.
  Cutoff is a Go time.Time param (same storage format as stored rows).
- Metrics: nexus_metrics_prune_last_rows + _timestamp_seconds gauges,

The four package-level Default*Patterns vars in internal/router/dsl.go
used regexp.MustCompile, so a syntax error in a default pattern (e.g.
during a future edit) crashed the proxy with a runtime panic instead of
a structured boot error.

Replace each MustCompile with mustCompileDefaultPattern, a package-level
init guard that:
- compiles via regexp.Compile (no panic)
- on invalid syntax, log.Fatalf with a message identifying the pattern
  group (formatting/fusion/local/unicode) and the offending expression
- exposes a testable core (compileDefaultPattern) returning a descriptive
  error

Tests cover:
- compileDefaultPattern returns a clear, group-labelled error for invalid
  patterns across all four groups (no panic)
- the boot guard exits non-zero with a descriptive logged message for
  each group (subprocess test)
- the package-level defaults are populated and functional","messageHeadline":"fix: resolve #588 — replace DSL MustCompile with graceful error handl…","oid":"3ccc1208841a3aff2b3e73774edce9051706932e"},{"authoredDate":"2026-07-26T20:16:52Z","authors":[{"email":"achapin@nrel.gov","id":"MDQ6VXNlcjYzMjYyOTQ=","login":"anchapin","name":"Alex Chapin"}],"committedDate":"2026-07-26T20:16:52Z","messageBody":"","messageHeadline":"fix: resolve #590 — add ProviderStatsCache.Run lifecycle coverage (#628)","oid":"6562585c5fc5bb7514dc2f1324b7ddb48ac6795f"},{"authoredDate":"2026-07-26T20:33:08Z","authors":[{"email":"achapin@nrel.gov","id":"MDQ6VXNlcjYzMjYyOTQ=","login":"anchapin","name":"Alex Chapin"}],"committedDate":"2026-07-26T20:33:08Z","messageBody":"","messageHeadline":"feat: resolve #584 — build and publish Windows binary (#629)","oid":"f6c7548b33476e066dc47d3f84dc81b096684015"},{"authoredDate":"2026-07-26T20:35:48Z","authors":[{"email":"achapin@nrel.gov","id":"MDQ6VXNlcjYzMjYyOTQ=","login":"anchapin","name":"Alex Chapin"}],"committedDate":"2026-07-26T20:35:48Z","messageBody":"Sets PRAGMA auto_vacuum=INCREMENTAL via DSN pragma for fresh databases
